answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network cultivates a permissioned garden where identity creation demands cryptographic stake burning. As an adversary spawns identities, required burned collateral scales with superlinear cost, O(N^2), pushing resource depletion to its zenith. This unforgeable economic friction acts as a sable cloak over malicious swarms, ensuring the marginal cost to coordinate rapidly outpaces any protocol exploit payoff.
